Class ModelLessonsList

java.lang.Object
guiLessonsList.ModelLessonsList
public class ModelLessonsList extends Object

Title: ModelLessonsList Class.

Description: The Lessons Learned list page Model. It holds the list of every stored lesson and decides which of them the page shows, given the search term, the category filter, and the "only my lessons" choice the user has made, and what the status line under the list says.

In most of the supplied GUI packages the Model is an empty stub, because those pages hold no data of their own. This page does: it narrows a list and has to explain the result. That logic is kept here rather than in the View or the Controller for two reasons. It contains no JavaFX, so the testing automation can check exactly the decision the page makes without opening a window. And it keeps the View to building widgets and the Controller to reacting to them, which is the division the supplied packages follow.

Contributor stories supported: CS-2 (see all lessons, and be told in words when there are none), CS-4 (search), CS-5 (filter by category), CS-6 (only my lessons).

  • Field Details

    • ALL_CATEGORIES

      public static final String ALL_CATEGORIES
      The text shown in the category filter for "do not filter by category". It is a constant so the View that offers it and the Model that recognises it cannot spell it differently, and it is taken from LessonInputPolicy so validation refuses exactly this name as a real category.
      See Also:

    • allLessons

      private static entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList allLessons
      Source: CS-2. Every stored lesson, newest first, read when the page is displayed. The lesson editor and the lesson detail page use this same list, so a change made on either of them is already in the list when the user comes back, without reading every row again.

    • shownLessons

      private static entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList shownLessons
      Source: CS-2 to CS-6. The subset currently on screen, in the order shown, so the row the user selects can be turned back into the lesson it describes.

    • applyFilters

      public static entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList applyFilters(entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList all, String searchTerm, String category, boolean onlyMine, String userName)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList applyFilters(LessonsLearnedList all, String searchTerm, String category, boolean onlyMine, String userName)

      Description: Narrows the full list in three independent steps. Each step is skipped when the user has not asked for it, so with no search term, all categories, and the box unticked, the whole list is shown (CS-2). An empty search term therefore means "do not search" on this page rather than "match nothing", which is what LessonsLearnedList. searchByText returns for it; the page has a separate Show All button, so the user is never left looking at an empty list because the search box happens to be empty.

      The steps are applied search first, then category, then ownership, but the result is the same in any order, because each step only removes lessons.

      Parameters:
      all - the full list
      searchTerm - the text in the search box, which may be empty
      category - the category chosen, or ALL_CATEGORIES
      onlyMine - true when only the user's own lessons should be shown
      userName - the logged in username
      Returns:
      the subset to show, possibly empty

    • statusMessage

      public static String statusMessage(int shown, int total, String searchTerm, String category, boolean onlyMine)

      Method: String statusMessage(int shown, int total, String searchTerm, String category, boolean onlyMine)

      Description: The line under the list that says what the user is looking at. CS-2 and CS-4 both require that an empty result is explained in words rather than shown as a blank list, because a blank list looks the same as a page that did not work. The message names the filters that produced an empty result, so the user knows which one to change.

      Parameters:
      shown - how many lessons are shown
      total - how many lessons are stored
      searchTerm - the search term in use, which may be empty
      category - the category in use, or ALL_CATEGORIES
      onlyMine - whether only the user's own lessons are shown
      Returns:
      the message to display
